node.label: George L Mosse
node.date_label: Nationalism and Sexuality (1985) · Fallen Soldiers (1990) · The Image of Man (1996)
node.description: Historian of modern European nationalism and the cultural politics of exclusion. Steven Aschheim reads Mosse’s work as linking national mobilization to bourgeois respectability and masculine stereotypes, while Fallen Soldiers investigates the political remaking of wartime death. Aschheim also questions aspects of this interpretation; cultural analysis does not make Nazi violence inevitable or erase institutional and material forces.
